About Jessica
REALTOR® | CRM Certified

Modern Real Estate.
Intelligent Investments.

My name is Okereke Chizaram — fondly called Jessica. I'm a licensed real estate agent and investment consultant operating across Nigeria's most dynamic property markets.

I specialize in connecting local and diaspora clients with verified, high-appreciation properties — from residential leases to strategic land banking. My approach blends deep market knowledge with a digitally connected, nomadic workflow.

Every transaction I facilitate is built on transparency, proper documentation, and an obsessive commitment to results. Whether buying, leasing, or diversifying into real estate investment — I make the process simple and secure.
